summary.text: Rachel Crowther is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 90, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Democratic primary.
A small business owner from the Rockford area, she says she is a current Courtland Township trustee.

paragraphs.text: Crowther earned a high school diploma from Port Huron Northern High School and a bachelor's degree from Central Michigan University.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a longtime Rockford resident and said her service includes the Rockford Area Community Foundation, the Courtland Township Parks Committee, Experience Grand Rapids and the Kent County Lodging Association.
She said she was named the 2016 Joe Tomaselli Hotelier of the Year.
Crowther listed her key messages as building local economies and growing small businesses, protecting natural resources and rural character, and transparent, accountable government.
She also named women's rights, mental health, veterans and rural health care as policy priorities.
